# Tier 3 of lre-compat.yml (report-only): rotation.sh picks a few of these
# per ISO week, so every one runs every other week or so.
#
# One image per line: <ref> <family|none> [<prep command>]
#   ref     what a person would type in the app (linux/arm64 must exist)
#   family  the package family lre/image must detect; none = no package
#           manager we know (the unknown-family path)
#   prep    what the agent must run before the install command on this
#           distro, the rest of the line (ripgrep is in EPEL on RHEL-likes)
debian:11 apt
ubuntu:20.04 apt
almalinux:latest dnf dnf install -y epel-release
amazonlinux:latest dnf
oraclelinux:9 dnf dnf install -y oracle-epel-release-el9
busybox:latest none
kalilinux/kali-rolling:latest apt
